metadata.citation: Kodak, KODAK PROFESSIONAL T-MAX 100 Film, F-4016, June 2018, page 8; D-76 20 C 7.5-minute characteristic curve and 0.3-above-D-min log-sensitivity curve.
metadata.datasource: https://www.kodakprofessional.com/sites/default/files/wysiwyg/pro/resources/f4016_TMax_100.pdf; PDF SHA256 00518d7d1e296d6065f6e41ea3db999e5d8714679fb3d2b76d9a49eb207113be; source SHA256 45cc4a33aa3d040a5c1bc7d246a933421699c87dadc69e70303362df13308a49. 100TMX 135; KODAK D-76 stock, small tank, 20 C, 7.5 min curve, intermittent agitation; diffuse visual density. Exposure origin -0.84659389416 log10(lux seconds). Rebuild scripts/prepare_tmax100.py; see docs/tmax100.md. Publication drawing, not batch-specific measurement. The first plotted density 0.213071 at logE -3.14997 is a base-density proxy, not a measured D-min. The p8 7.5-minute curve is the selected printed curve; p3 lists 6.5 minutes at 68 F as a starting-point table value. Do not silently substitute one for the other. The spectral plot gives 0.3 and 1.0 above D-min curves; 0.3 is used as the profile baseline, 1.0 is retained for ablation, not a second layer. No measured silver/base spectrum, grain calibration, halation PSF, or scanner response is supplied. The characteristic curve clamps outside the plotted range; no inferred shoulder or extra latitude. One aggregate silver record; not a measured emulsion sublayer decomposition. Scope is the 135 source identity. The built-in look preserves caller format and is not separately calibrated for 120/sheet; no 120/sheet material or 2026 Ektapan 100 alias is delivered; Ektapan identity is unverified. The selected 7.5-minute p8 curve is not the p3 table value (6.5 minutes at 68 F); the table is a starting-point recommendation and was not silently substituted. The 0.3-above-D-min spectral curve is the baseline; the 1.0 curve is retained for ablation, not treated as a second measured layer. The spectral log offset is normalized by the existing engine-matched adapter; the absolute sensitivity scale is not an ISO calibration. Spectral tails outside the plotted domain are endpoint-slope assumptions, not measured cutoffs. One aggregate silver record is used; this is not a measured emulsion sublayer decomposition. Exposure zero is the first plotted density plus 1.0; 0.213071 is not a measured D-min, and D55 RGB midgray mapping is not absolute ISO or output-brightness calibration. No measured base spectrum, silver grain, halation PSF or scanner response is supplied by the publication. The antihalation metadata tag is a conservative weak default; the sheet does not publish a halation PSF. The preset grain is an approximation based on RMS 8 at 48 micrometers and D-min+1.0; it is not a per-channel grain calibration. Real scans are used for qualitative review only and cannot identify a scanner-independent material response.
